title: AIVD 3.45 GENERAL PLANNER EXPLORATION FIX (intervention)

insertion_point.rationale: Atom lazy n_mat=1 + allow_atom_lazy early break is the established starvation site (3.41–3.44). Prim/ext lazy paths left unchanged (smallest insertion).

policy.name: EXPLOIT_PLUS_BOUNDED_EXPLORE
policy.exploit: lazy base width 1 (eager 4); always preserves rank-0 / board head
policy.explore: at most +1 slot when (a) first-window diversity with unexplored beyond cut OR (b) skip_count>=threshold with under-explored candidate; budget-gated by leftover//chain_floor and invent_slots_left
policy.anti_starvation: skip_count / materialization_count / exploration_opportunities / last_materialized_epoch; surface starved candidate just after exploit cut

offline_replay.note: CF inventions are NOT real inventions. S-key exposure is observation only.

ablation.selection_rule: breadth + bounded cost + exploitation preservation; NOT single-candidate success
ablation.why: Matches FIX_B first-window diversity lift (+1) while remaining adaptive under tight leftover (explore withheld when leftover<6) and capping opportunities per candidate — avoids unconditional width inflation.

candidate_specific_grep.scope: aivd/science/exploration_alloc.py + added lines of designer.py vs 72edfad

known_limitations: Offline replay does not fully resimulate post-invent rank demotion trajectories (NOT_RECORDED).
Prim/ext lazy n_mat paths unchanged (atom path only).
Exploration opportunity does not guarantee invention (by design).
max_opportunities_per_candidate=1 may underserve after firewall reset until reset() — allocator resets on firewall board clear.
